title: 10 Top Website Hero Images and Best Practices to Create Your Own

facts.fact: The article states it will list the top 15 most attractive Hero sections, although its title says 10.
facts.quote: In the following lines, we’ll make a list of the top 15 most attractive Hero sections in websites:

facts.fact: The article defines a website Hero as the introductory image in the upper part of a website's pages, usually an image connected with text (title, subtitle and call-to-action).
facts.quote: A website Hero is the introductory image in the upper part of a website pages. It usually refers to an image, but it’s also connected with text (title, subtitle and call-to-action).

facts.fact: The 66nord Hero example uses a carousel with one slide for each destination included in the 66Nord offers.
facts.quote: It shows images in a carousel, one slide for each destination included in the 66Nord offers.
